rows.scene: A single centered lotus-seated creator in shallow mural space, surrounded by wide concentric cosmic forms; keep all four arms and lotus inside safe margins.
rows.candidate_status: v006, 1672x941. Broad concentric cream, muted rose-ochre and olive rings visibly surround the lotus-seated figure. Three distinct faces are visible (front and two profiles); the rear-facing fourth head is hidden behind the central head as specified. Four attached arms are visible. One foot shows five distinct toes; the other foot is mostly covered by the dhoti and its toes cannot be reliably counted. Enlarged crops show the book grip with a thumb and four visible fingers, although the thumb is partly occluded; the pot, lotus and mala grips obscure some digits, so exact counts on all four hands are uncertain. Skin-only 16x16 patch at x=800,y=220 has median RGB (205,116,57), R-B 148; torso patch at x=800,y=400 is (198,111,54), R-B 144. Both read distinctly orange compared with the warm muted rose-ochre Brahma contract. Neck and arms have a pendant/bead strands, one mala and multiple arm bands. No other people, duplicate Brahma, text or beams. Producer review uncertain; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending.
